blocks.text: Once again we are at a wonderful time of the year! The smell of fall and winter is in the air. The bright colors of our changing seasons appearing and a time to be thankful for the birth of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. – Signs are all around us. Since 2001 many signs in the heavens have taken place. – Years before the birth of Christ there were many signs given in the heavens and again just before Christ appears there will be signs in the heavens pointing to His return! (Luke 21:25) – And now a wonderful quote from Neal Frisby’s library.

The wise men and the star of the east are inseparably associated with Christ’s birth. “I believe what appeared to the wise men was the ‘pillar of fire’ because it was ready to condense itself and enter the child! And later this same ‘pillar of fire’ would walk among them!” Matt. 2:9-10, the verse declares the star went before them until it stood over the child! The star actually changed its direction as they traveled, much like the cloud and pillar of fire did to the children of Israel!

From the very beginning of the Scriptures it reveals many many secrets couched in mysteries concerning the coming of Christ our Saviour, from Gen. 3:15 throughout the Bible. It showed the seed Jesus would be associated to. Also Gen. 1:16-19, on the fourth day the sun shone! And 4,000 years later the Sun of Righteousness came! He said, before Abraham was, I am. – The Bible reveals His first coming as a baby. (Matt. 2:1) – His second coming (Translation - I Thess. 4:16-17) – His third coming (Armageddon – Rev. Chap. 19) – The Pyramidical truth inched His birth about the same time of the 4,000 years! The heavens shewed forth His first coming, and now they are depicting His Second Coming and beyond and so does the prophetic Scripture. (Matt. 24: 33-35)

Look how these ancient prophecies was definitely fulfilled. – Micah 5:2 - But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, and from everlasting. – Isa. 9:6 - For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace. – So we see the men were truly wise men, for they brought gifts which identified Him and revealed His mission! Amen! The significance is an amazing mystery, but it is a divine truth! “He was God’s divine gift to the world, fully anointed for service!”

Isa. 53 gives a beautiful revelation prophecy, but suffering of His coming! We will list just a few verses, 2-5 but read the whole chapter. “For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him. He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not. Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted. But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.” It says Jesus had no comeliness; nothing to look upon. He was despised so He could direct them to the Word and the miracles! But in His glorified state He is the fairest of 10,000! – Isa. 43:11 - I even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no savior.

The elect will be like the wise men, they will see the signs in the heaven and understand His coming! And even now more comets and heavenly activity is appearing. As the light shown around the shepherds, (Luke 2:8-9) it will also shine around us and we will be translated.

Here is some prophecy! Note: The revived religious and government Empire is now rising only awaiting the coming leader! “The Covenant is approaching! Rejoice!” This is a wonderful Scripture for His chosen. Dan. 12:3 - And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars forever and ever. End quote.

This month I am releasing a book called “El Shaddai” and DVD, Christ in Every Book of the Bible. You’ll find them very uplifting, full of knowledge and interesting! We did a tremendous amount of witnessing this past year and I’m asking for your continued help as we will be entering a New Year. I’ll be praying for you for the Lord Jesus to bless and guide you with His great wisdom. May you have a Very Merry Christmas and Happy Holiday season.
